jurisdiction_trap.details: Exclusively mandates the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, Sherman Division, or the State Courts of Collin County, Texas. This imposes severe travel, lodging, and local counsel costs on any user residing outside of northeastern Texas.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: The Demand must include... the original personal signature of the party seeking arbitration... For purposes of this paragraph, 'original personal signature' does not include any digital, scanned, electronic, copied, or facsimile signature.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: You cannot use modern electronic signatures (like DocuSign) to start a legal dispute. You must physically sign a paper document and mail it, creating an intentional administrative hurdle to discourage claims.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: any of your Content (including but not limited to the Inputs), as well as your purchasing history from the Walmart Sites, your use of promotions as well as personal information, may be used to further enhance and improve the Generative AI Features, the underlying model and the Walmart Sites as well as to generate Output.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: Walmart will feed your chat prompts, shopping history, and personal data directly into their AI models to train them, and you cannot opt out if you use their AI features.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: by uploading Photos into your Walmart Digital Photo Center Account, you agree to waive all moral rights to those images.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: If you upload photos to print them, you forfeit your legal right to object to how Walmart edits, alters, or displays your personal images.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: Though you have a right to use all Outputs generated by the Generative AI Features, the Outputs are owned by Walmart.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: Any creative or functional text/images you generate using Walmart's AI tools belong entirely to Walmart, not you.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: You agree that it your responsibility to regularly check Walmart.com for any updated Terms of Use. In addition, by continuing to use or access any of the Walmart Sites or otherwise engaging with Walmart after we post any changes, you accept the updated Terms of Use.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: Walmart can change the rules of this contract at any time without telling you. It is your job to constantly check their website to see if they have quietly rewritten the terms.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: You agree to defend (at Walmart’s option), indemnify, and hold the Walmart Entities harmless from and against any and all liabilities, claims, damages, costs, and expenses, including but not limited to those related to electronically stored information (hereinafter, 'ESI'), expert fees, attorneys’ fees and costs, arising from or related to your misuse of the Walmart Sites or any breach by you of these Terms of Use.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: If Walmart gets sued because of something you did or allegedly breached, you must pay for their lawyers, expert witnesses, and data discovery costs, even if the claim is completely groundless.

strategic_recommendation: ABANDON OR AIR-GAP: Avoid using Walmart's digital services, specifically their Generative AI features and Digital Photo Center, which strip you of moral rights and harvest your personal data for AI training. If you must shop at Walmart, do so in-store with cash to bypass the predatory digital Terms of Use, forced arbitration, and the physical-signature dispute trap.

target_evasion_tactics: Burying AI training consent in specialized service sub-sections
Imposing a physical-only 'original signature' requirement to invalidate electronic legal representation
Using a highly restrictive venue (Sherman Division, TX) to price out average consumers from seeking judicial relief
